# pangolin_access_tokens (Data Source)

Lists every resource access token in the organization.

> **Note:** the bearer secret is never returned by this endpoint — only the SHA-256 `token_hash` is exposed. Filter by `resource_id` in HCL to scope to a single resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_access_tokens" "all" {}

# All tokens bound to a single resource.
output "ci_bot_tokens" {
  value = [
    for t in data.pangolin_access_tokens.all.access_tokens : t
    if t.resource_id == pangolin_resource.filebrowser.id
  ]
}

# Tokens about to expire (within the next 24h, epoch milliseconds).
output "expiring_soon" {
  value = [
    for t in data.pangolin_access_tokens.all.access_tokens : t
    if t.expires_at != null && t.expires_at < timestamp() + 86400000
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `access_tokens` (Attributes List) List of access tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--access_tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp (epoch ms).
- `description` (String) Optional description. Null when unset.
- `expires_at` (Number) Expiration timestamp (epoch ms). Null when the token never expires.
- `id` (String) The access token ID.
- `resource_id` (Number) The HTTP resource this token authorizes.
- `resource_name` (String) Display name of the parent resource.
- `resource_nice_id` (String) Human-readable ID of the parent resource.
- `session_length` (Number) Lifetime in milliseconds.
- `site_name` (String) Site name for site-level resources. Null otherwise.
- `title` (String) Optional human-readable title. Null when unset.
- `token_hash` (String) SHA-256 hash of the bearer token.
